json.notes: White Victorian timber-and-glass conservatory. A central two-tier glazed dome on an octagonal drum with a finial reaches 15 m. Low glazed vaults run along each wing, ending in small domed end pavilions with finials. A low brick base runs round the building. A front entrance porch sits at the centre, and a lower rear service range sits behind.
